en.title: Osmanlı Kunafa

steps.n1: Break up the kunafa pastry into fine strands using your fingers.
steps.n2: Sauté the kunafa in the melted ghee until it turns golden brown.
steps.n4: Spread half of the kunafa in a round dish, then layer the cream or clotted cream on top.
steps.n5: Add the remaining kunafa and press down firmly with your hands.
steps.n6: Garnish with either pistachios or hazelnuts.

Garnish with either pistachios or hazelnuts.
